description: Figure 6(b) illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter N on the AUC (%) for five different methods, represented by distinct colored lines with corresponding markers: orange for SMD, blue for PSM, green for SWaT, magenta for SMAP, and yellow for MSL. The x-axis, labeled "N," spans from 0 to 20 in linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "AUC (%)," ranges from 70 to 100 in linear scale. The orange line (SMD) starts at approximately 90%, rises to a peak near 95% at N=10, then declines to about 90% at N=20. The blue line (PSM) begins at approximately 90%, rises to a peak near 95% at N=10, then declines to about 90% at N=20. The green line (SWaT) starts at approximately 85%, rises to a peak near 95% at N=10, then declines to about 85% at N=20. The magenta line (SMAP) begins at approximately 80%, rises sharply to a peak near 95% at N=10, then declines to about 80% at N=20. The yellow line (MSL) starts at approximately 85%, rises to a peak near 95% at N=10, then declines to about 85% at N=20. All lines show a similar trend of increasing AUC to a maximum around N=10, followed by a decrease.
